correctness.rationale: The exact PAGE branches yield a closed second-moment matrix. Its characteristic cubic has binding Jury factor \(\alpha[2+3\alpha-2(1+2h^2)\alpha^2]/9\). The package proves \(|c_3|<1\), the \(-1\) Jury inequality, and the reduced Schur determinant \(J>0\) throughout the proposed region, with explicit endpoint factorizations. Equality gives eigenvalue \(1\), so the radical threshold is necessary and sufficient.

value.rationale: The two-component model is the smallest finite sum retaining PAGE's defining full-refresh/recursive-correction switch and genuine curvature heterogeneity. The source probability formula makes \(p=1/3\) canonical for \(b=2,b'=1\). The exact radical frontier quantifies how heterogeneity erodes allowable stepsize, shows affine noninterpolation offsets cancel, and supplies a sharp benchmark against the sufficient PAGE/L2S stepsize rules.
